<reason>CON won the additionality clash. PRO pivoted well from physical delivery to behavior incentives, but CON showed the same behavior could be rewarded by time-varying export/consumption tariffs, exposed the regulate-wires-but-not-tariffs contradiction, and showed PRO double-counted avoided costs while leaving the funding of both discount and premium after full cost recovery unproven.</reason>
<best_rebuttal>CON's Rebuttal 1 to Rebuttal 2 sequence demanding trading vs direct reward comparison and showing relabeling buyer creates no new physical saving was decisive; PRO's toll-road reply never solved curtailment or full capacity/balancing cost recovery.</best_rebuttal>
